articles.title: Got new Apple gear on the way? Pick up these Beats USB-C cables (60% off)
articles.description: Macworld Beats USB-C Cables (2-pack) Apple has a lot of new things to buy, and they all have one thing in common: cables, specifically USB-C cables. And if you’ve got some new stuff coming, you’re not going to want to use those old frayed cables anymore. Over at Amazon, you can get a two-pack of five-foot woven Beats cables for just $14. That’s just $7 a piece and a fantastic deal for excellent cables. These cables may have the Beats logo on them, but that doesn’t mean you can only use them to recharge your Beats headphones. In fact, they’ll work with just about any device in your arsenal, from iPhones to AirPods and even your MacBook. The cables can push up to 60W of power, so they’re suitable for fast-charging a wide range of gadgets. You can even use them in a pinch to transfer data, though with USB 2.0 speeds, you’ll mostly want to stick to charging. The Beats cables are covered in sturdy braided nylon so they’ll live through all the times you’ll coil them around your hand before throwing them at the bottom of the laptop bag. This also means they’re better prepared to survive the fraying that ruins so many cheap cables. Plus they’re longer than than the cables Apple supplies. At 5ft, you won’t have to be on the very edge of your bed while your iPhone is charging. So, don’t miss out on the chance to grab these awesome Beats USB-C cables for $14 before the deal runs out.

articles.title: Euro 1983 Ferrari 308 GTS Quattrovalvole w/ Koenig Widebody
articles.description: This European-market 1983 Ferrari 308 GTS Quattrovalvole was imported to the US and federalized in the early 1980s and spent much of its life in Texas. Finished in Rosso Chiaro over Beige leather, the car has been modified with Koenig wide bodywork with vented rear fenders. Its 2.9-liter quad-cam V8 received a timing belt service in 2026, and additional work in preparation for the sale included recharging the air conditioning system, reupholstering the seats, refinishing the 18" BBS wheels, replacing the ignition wires, and installing QA1 coilovers and Michelin tires. Additional equipment includes a five-speed manual transaxle, a limited-slip differential, pop-up headlights, a removable roof panel, a quad-exit exhaust system, a gated shifter, and electric windows. This 308 GTS Quattrovalvole is now offered by the selling dealer as part of DriverSource's Oktmotorfest 2026 Collection with service records, manufacturer's literature, spare parts, a clean Carfax report, and a clean Texas title.
